head: BabyBackup turns two phones or iPads into a baby monitor
dek: BabyBackup makes a baby monitor from two devices you already own: one stays with your baby, you keep the other and listen. It was #10 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: There's no account, no subscription and no internet needed. It came out on 5 November and costs $4.99, by Point Rider.
means: If you need a spare baby monitor for a trip or a visit, your old phone can do the job.
todo: Find BabyBackup in the App Store and install it on both devices.
